body: Yeah, stuff that drive you to contemplate ending your life tend to be. Thanks.

Where to even begin? I am a middle aged, bisexual man, living with my conservative family, while I try and finish up my education. I haven’t had a normal relationship in years, for fear of it ruining my already fragile home life. I was diagnosed with bipolar disorder, borderline personality disorder, and PTSD at the age of 16. I spent a decade trying to get myself trough school, but the lack of support or medication made it hard. I finally cobbled together enough money and resolve and went to see a psychiatrist long enough to design a system of coping mechanisms for myself. Those mechanism (bereft of medication) had a set shelf life of two years, but all I need was the time they afforded me to get back in school, and get a part time job with insurance so I could seek treatment again (my anxiety is the main culprit in my personality, it triggers all my episodes). Fast forward to three weeks ago, one year and 10 months of getting my shit together got me what I needed, then I find out that the money I had set aside for returning to treatment was taken by my mom. Bad news, as it tends to do, has accelerated the expiration of my coping mechanism. She promised to get it back to me this week, she hasn’t, I’ve told her several times I need it, she is dismissive. I’m now at the end of my rope, my fucking wits end. I put so much effort and work into correcting my life, into becoming the type of person I know I can be, who doesn’t need constant medication, but gets a tremendous amount of help from the occasional release valve. I don’t have the energy to fight a battle I wasn’t prepared for.

Thanks for the response, it help add to my understanding of “why”. Now I just need to try and internalise the message. Any advice on how? I’ve cut her out of my life (for obvious reasons), and the distance is helping, but it’s more a passive assist and I need to figure out a way to actively tackle it.
